kids.name: value
kids.chars: Clicking outside the identity check window moves the keyboard position to the page behind it. (2.4.3)

kids.name: value
kids.chars: Keyboard and screen reader users lose their place and may type into the wrong area.

kids.name: value
kids.chars: Press Escape to close the window, then open it again from the same button.

kids.name: value
kids.chars: While signing in, at the two-factor step and after a password change, the keyboard position can jump back to the start of the page. (2.4.3)

kids.name: value
kids.chars: Keyboard and screen reader users must find their place again, and nothing is read out.

kids.name: value
kids.chars: Press Tab once to reach the first field of the new step.

kids.name: value
kids.chars: Some messages on the sign-in and identity check screens are read out every second, or are not read out at all. (4.1.3)

kids.name: value
kids.chars: Screen reader users hear a long run of repeats, or miss that a code was not sent.

kids.name: value
kids.chars: Read the message under the field with your screen reader's reading keys.

kids.name: value
kids.chars: At very high zoom the lock and identity check windows and one page do not fit, so some buttons are cut off. (1.4.10)

kids.name: value
kids.chars: People who zoom in a lot may not reach the Unlock or Confirm buttons.

kids.name: value
kids.chars: Zoom out one step, or use the in-app text size control instead.

kids.name: value
kids.chars: When the connection comes back, the app does not say so. (4.1.3)

kids.name: value
kids.chars: Screen reader users hear that the connection dropped but not that it recovered.

kids.name: value
kids.chars: Check the connection status in the status bar at the bottom of the window.

kids.name: value
kids.chars: Two links on the appearance settings page are hard to read in the dark and high-contrast themes. (1.4.3)

kids.name: value
kids.chars: People with low vision may not see the links to this statement and to the keyboard shortcuts.

kids.name: value
kids.chars: Switch to the light theme, or move to the links with Tab.
